notes.title: Новый персонаж! 🌊 Знакомьтесь: Мариандра! 🌊
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864167/0604fbe5cc231cb33b673a5e7b47825d1c82b37c.png[/img]
[i]Hello, islanders![/i]
Today we’ll finally introduce a new character from DLC Shadows of the Past!
Something from the depths… And no, it’s not a sea monster, it’s our new lovely heroine - Mariandra! 🐠

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3467870/Lyndaria_Shadows_of_the_Past_DLC

She is an emmisary from the sea folk. She looks around 21 years old, but who knows how old she is really? Maybe she’s older than the first steamboat, or maybe she still remembers the time when everything was below sea level. No one asked her, and she doesn’t bother correcting people. 😏

[h3][b]🐚 What do you need to know about Mariandra?[/b][/h3]
✨ She’s amphibious - she can be both in water and on land
✨ Educated and curious
✨ Always acts in the interest of her people, but she’s really drawn to Maya and her knowledge
✨ Anxious about being misunderstood, constantly correcting herself and apologizing
✨ Her emotions are a cocktail of curiosity, wonder and endless surprise. You really want to get on her nerves? Good luck, it’s practically impossible. 😆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864167/bc00573af24972eea0476a3c931a136802dd3b9e.png[/img]

What human habits do you think Mariandra has the most trouble dealing with? Do you think that you’ll get some time to closely get to know each other in this DLC? 😏 Share your ideas in the comments! ⬇️

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864167/cd71e1231af60733c6106c092862d1ee095c97b9.png[/img]

✨Hello, our favourite gamers!
Congratulations to everyone on the release of Lyndaria. Many thanks to all the players for your support! 💓
Everything went smoothly and there were no critical bugs. We are very happy about it, because we tried to fix most of the bugs early on. 💪🏻

However, it was not without minor bugs... We are also trying to reproduce and fix little issues that you had. We are working on our mistakes :)

Thank you for writing us comments or letting us know about problems in [url=https://discord.gg/tophouse]Discord[/url]. We realized you were missing autosaves and quickly tried to write code for them, testing on dev builds all the time since release, and then pouring 5 updates on Steam to make sure everything was working as intended and update you. So if you've noticed version updates, know that we've been doing some quick tests. But now we're 99% sure that autosaves are working properly, and we're ready to let you know for sure! 😋

Please report any bugs, even minor issues, on our [url=https://discord.gg/tophouse]Discord channel[/url], and we'll fix them immediately in the next update. 

[b]Here's what we've fixed so far:[/b]

- Added autosave (now it's safe to play)
- Fixed minor bugs in quests, locations and scenes.

The update is already out on Steam. So check it out 😘

[b][i]💓 Also we want to ask you: what do you really like about the game? Write your answers in the comments, we'll read them later with the whole team 💓[/i][/b]
